plugin.name: analytix-fund-analysis
plugin.runtime_boundary: Analytix-owned runtime only; no system Codex hooks, config, cache, or plugin state.

not_for: object dossier once task is clear
focused_skills.completion_standard: current case/status, available lanes, and next focused skill suggestions; no full-case/report gate
Case Scope Card with coverage, quality boundaries, and next focused skill choices
复核意见应列明已有数据支持的事实、待核线索风险、当前证据不足的统计项和补充核验方向
一轮内给出低风险事实快查结论，写明指标、方向、范围、覆盖情况、金额/笔数和证据边界；特定双方资金往来核验和金额争议必须转交 pair-amount-investigation。

use_when: A transferred how much to B
focused_skills.completion_standard: 特定双方资金往来核验研判 with conclusion, period, raw/effective/dedup amount and count, large-transaction table, duplicate/key safety, account/time concentration, difference explanation, abnormal features, relationship/purpose leads, unsupported limits, and downstream/evidence requests.

账户资金画像 with opening/registry facts, linked contact/address clues, transaction-environment/IP/MAC/channel clues, scope, time span, inflow/outflow, Top counterparties, account role leads, behavior, anomalies, source/destination, evidence gaps, and investigation next steps

主体资金画像 with identity/opening facts, contact/address/employer and device/IP/MAC/channel correlation, registered accounts, account leads needing proof, per-account roles, account structure, inflow/outflow, Top accounts/counterparties, source/destination, group-association leads, anomalies, evidence gaps, and investigation next steps
counterparty priorities, evidence status, account/missing-boundary separation, payment/merchant/platform leads, and subpoena targets
列明可证实交易边、待核停顿点、现金/资产/理财/支付/商户/平台/虚拟资产/跨境端点边界、余额承接缺口和补调核验动作

hypothesis queue with evidence status, account role candidates, contact/address/device/IP/MAC leads, group-association leads, payment/merchant/platform/virtual-asset leads, total-vs-classified splits, cost-normality findings, normality downgrades, verified facts, forbidden-as-fact items, and next actions

Full-case fact tree with data scale, cleaned/index/report coverage, account/contact/address/transaction-environment/task feedback/coercive coverage, subject/account/counterparty rankings, group-association leads, account roles, cash/asset/financial/payment/merchant/platform/virtual-asset/cross-border/tax-contract leads, two-layer public-to-private stats, cost normality, supported flows, gaps, and continuation queue
report draft/materialization boundary with verified facts, corrected claims, unsupported claims, and source boundaries
prioritized evidence request list with target, request item, field/time scope, linked lead or gap, expected proof value, priority, evidence boundary, and next action
critique verdict with missing lanes, weak evidence boundaries, wrong-route risks, overclaims, and recommended next focused skill or command
给出可采信/当前证据不足/需降级的复核意见、修正表述、来源边界、未支持链路边界和下一步补证事项
阻断或修正缺少查什么、结论、依据、异常、案件意义、不能认定事项、下一步取证，或泄露工程词的低质输出。

not_for: 待核路径写成已证实路径

evidence-bound tables, charts, dashboard cards, or appendix/workbook inventory with scope, unit, time window, metric, direction, evidence status, unsupported visual claims, and next owner skill

use_when: semantic MCP tool insufficient for a bounded current-case-project analysis
not_for: account or subject dossier covered by semantic tools
fund tracing covered by semantic tools
weak-source substitution, unverified calculations, fake delivery, or fc_*_raw used as ordinary evidence
focused_skills.completion_standard: 专项资金核算 result or gap note, or a user-confirmed current-case cleaned export whose CSV/XLSX file was generated and read-checked; no weak-source substitution, unverified production fact, arbitrary-directory write, or fake delivery

task_taxonomy.label: Entry / Status
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: current case/status and next focused skill suggestions only; no full-case analysis or report generation

task_taxonomy.label: Case Context
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: scope, coverage, quality boundaries, and next focused skill choices

task_taxonomy.label: Quick Fact
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: deterministic answer with metric, scope, coverage, evidence status, and boundary

task_taxonomy.label: Pair Amount / 特定双方资金往来核验
use_when: A 转给 B 多少钱
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: 以经侦小研判材料回答两方资金事实：先讲清完整期间、金额/笔数、账户、逐笔构成、主要集中转账与集中交易以外逐笔往来的业务含义，再用金额表/重点交易表固定依据，解释原明细/有效去重/重复或证据不足金额、账户/时间集中、竞争金额差异、异常特征、案件意义、暂不能认定事项和已见下游/补证尾部；不得只填固定标题。

task_taxonomy.label: Ranking
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: rank dimension, metric, direction, rows, coverage counts, and boundary without broad frontdoor takeover

task_taxonomy.label: Data Quality
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: 数据质量事实、重复/待核边界、修正后统计范围和补充核验动作

task_taxonomy.label: 资金画像
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: 完整账户或主体资金画像，覆盖范围、时间跨度、资金流入流出、重点对手方、异常特征、证据缺口和核查建议

task_taxonomy.label: Counterparty
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: 区分已核对手方、缺失户名记录和待核补调对象

task_taxonomy.label: Trace / Continuation
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: 列明可见上游/下游来源、可证实交易链路、待核停顿点、余额承接缺口和补调核验动作

task_taxonomy.label: Investigation Lab
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: hypothesis queue with evidence status, verified facts, forbidden-as-fact items, and next actions

task_taxonomy.label: Full Case Analysis
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: full-case fact tree with data volume, time span, cleaning coverage, rankings, suspicious features, supported flows, leads, gaps, and continuation queue

task_taxonomy.label: Report
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: report materialization only after explicit report intent and claim review boundary

task_taxonomy.label: Claim / QA
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: 给出可采信/当前证据不足/需降级/需改走其他核验路径的意见、修正表述或路径、来源边界、未支持链路边界、取证清单、遗漏分析角度和下一步补证方向

task_taxonomy.label: Delivery QC / 研判材料交付复核
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: 结论、证据、异常、案件意义、边界、补证动作齐备且无工程词。

task_taxonomy.label: Graph Visualization
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: 图中只画可证实交易边，另列待核线索、证据缺口和升级为确定路径所需补证材料

task_taxonomy.label: Visual Evidence
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: reader-facing evidence tables, charts, dashboards, or appendices with scope, unit, time window, metric, direction, evidence status, and unsupported visual-claim boundaries

task_taxonomy.label: Passive Nonintervention
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: do not call Analytix tools, do not mention case facts, and complete the ordinary user task

task_taxonomy.label: 专项资金核算
use_when: field coverage, empty result, query failure, or SQL plan risk
semantic tool gap that must not become weak-source substitution
task_taxonomy.completion_standard: 当前案件只读清洗/分析范围内的 SQL 或 notebook 结果、限量预览、证据边界、明确能力缺口，或已生成并读取检查的清洗明细文件
